run_count_people_in_zone: run the inference_example.py to count people in polygon zones from a video using a Roboflow YOLO model
build_polygon_zones_from_config: build polygon zone configurations from a JSON file containing polygon coordinates
detect_objects_in_frame: detect people in a video frame using a Roboflow Inference model with configurable confidence and IoU thresholds
annotate_frame_with_zones: annotate a video frame with polygon zone boundaries and bounding boxes for detected people
create_video_sink_output: create a video sink to write annotated frames to an output video file
